# Tetorica Playground (hello_ymfm_wasm)

> Browser-based JavaScript playground, documentation, and WebAssembly tools for YM2612, YM2608, YM2203, and YM2610 FM synthesis.

Use the common Playground type definitions together with the type definition for the selected sound chip. The canonical examples are code that runs in the Playground.

## Documentation

- [For AI](./for-ai.html): AI-oriented entry point, execution contract, type definitions, and representative examples
- [Documentation](./index.html): Human-oriented project documentation and demos
- [Playground](./playground/): Interactive JavaScript Playground

## Type definitions

- [Common Playground API](./playground/tetorica-playground-globals.d.ts): Globals, live coding, samples, noise, effects, files, FM, and PSG APIs
- [YM2612 selection](./playground/tetorica-playground-ym2612.d.ts): Mega Drive / Genesis configuration
- [YM2608 selection](./playground/tetorica-playground-ym2608.d.ts): PC-98 configuration
- [YM2203 selection](./playground/tetorica-playground-ym2203.d.ts): Three-channel PC-98 configuration
- [YM2610 selection](./playground/tetorica-playground-ym2610.d.ts): Neo Geo configuration

## Examples

- [Canonical example source](./playground/playground_examples.js): Built-in examples used by the Playground
- [Live Loop](./playground/?ex=live-loop): Tempo, notes, and named loops
- [Ambient Choir Sample](./playground/?ex=ambient-choir-sample): Sample loading, effects, and live state
- [FM API Beep](./playground/?ex=fm-api-beep): Direct YM2612 setup
- [PSG Scale](./playground/?ex=psg-scale): SN76489-compatible tone API
- [Parallel FX](./playground/?ex=parallel-fx): Branched effect routing

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kyorohiro/hello_ymfm_wasm)
